title: Vigilens
description: Architected a multi-agent AI system analyzing live video feeds to detect kitchen safety violations and workflow inefficiencies, delivering real-time actionable insights via a React dashboard. Built backend pipeline integrating TwelveLabs video understanding, custom Health/Efficiency agents, and an interactive Google Docs policy training module.

title: Predicting League of Legends Game Winners
description: Engineered scikit-learn preprocessing pipelines over 150,348 observations of professional LoL esports data, isolating features at the 15-minute mark to prevent data leakage. Tuned a Random Forest model using GridSearchCV and 5-fold cross-validation, achieving 74.7% test accuracy.

title: Shopper Intention Prediction
description: Analyzed 12,330 e-commerce session logs utilizing logistic regression and Welch's t-tests to identify PageValues and BounceRates as critical conversion drivers. Surfaced user intent patterns demonstrating new visitors converted at nearly 2x the rate of returning visitors.

title: Persuasive and Deceptive Visualization

title: Interactive Visualization with D3
description: Developed interactive multi-view charts with brushing and linking to explore multidimensional datasets seamlessly.

title: Technical Documentation Series
